MAKE THE FIRST CONVERSATION USEFUL

Bring the challenge.
Start with the context.

An early discussion does not need a finished specification. A few practical details help the team understand the requirement and the most useful next step.

Email the team directly
01The problem
What happens today, who experiences the difficulty, and what should work better?
02The environment
Which devices, applications, websites, business platforms, or data sources are involved?
03The intended outcome
What would a useful first version or a successful pilot allow the team to do?
04The delivery context
Are there existing deadlines, a budget range, decision-makers, or dependencies to consider?
